t: Maximum Number of Intersections on the Chart
o: A horizontal line at height h intersects the polyline once per segment that strictly spans h, plus once for each vertex lying exactly on h that is a strict local extremum (a vertex passed through monotonically shouldn't double count, and a flat pass-through at a vertex counts once). Sweep integer-relevant heights: for each segment [u,v] add +1/-1 over the value range (min, max); add +1 bonus at heights of strict local extrema; take the max prefix sum. Example 1 gives 5 at height 1.5/2.
k: Segments strictly spanning h contribute 1 each; vertices at h contribute 1 iff they are strict local extrema (turning points).
Difference-array sweep over compressed coordinate values evaluates all candidate heights efficiently.

a.n: Approach 1: Coordinate-compressed difference sweep with extremum bonuses
a.i: Compress all y-values to ranks. For each segment, mark +1 just above min(u,v)'s rank and -1 at max(u,v)'s rank so prefix sums count strictly-spanning segments at each rank. Separately, each strict local extremum adds +1 at its own height (the line grazing the turning point crosses both incident segments but counts once). Answer = max over ranks of (spanning count + bonus). Non-integer lines between consecutive distinct values see the same spanning count, so evaluating at ranks suffices.
s: Collect sorted unique values and rank-map them.
Diff array: for each segment, diff[rank(min)+1]++, diff[rank(max)]--.
Bonus array: for each vertex that is a strict local extremum, bonus[rank(y[i])]++.
Prefix-sum the diff and take the max of count+bonus.
a.t: O(n log n) — sorting/compression dominates; the sweep is linear.
a.sp: O(n) for the compressed arrays and maps.

w: Verify on example 1 mentally: peaks/valleys at 1 and 2 add bonuses, and the sweep counts spanning segments — max reaches 5. Pitfalls: no horizontal segments exist (given), endpoints of the chart count as extrema (one-sided comparison), and the bonus applies only at exact vertex heights. A follow-up might ask for the maximizing line itself — track argmax during the sweep.
